dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily located near the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region anterior to the gill slits displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more tightly packed high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank.
